The balance sheet is highly leveraged, with liabilities covering about 92% of assets and equity only ~8% of the asset base, while liquidity is very weak given a 0.34 current ratio and deeply negative working capital. Although the company remains profitable at the EBIT level and has positive retained earnings, the capital structure and short-term liquidity profile point to meaningful credit risk consistent with the lower speculative-grade range.

DECISION: B-
